name: Spanish Core
orderingNote: Ordered by web frequency (wordfreq), lemmatised. Ranks 1-5,000 come from the first generation pass; ranks 5,001-10,000 were appended later (lemmas resolved through Wiktionary inflection tables; names, vulgar words, abbreviations and inflected forms removed) and include numerals and a few core function words the first pass missed.
